pinch_points.suggested_strategy: Extract Interface: Define a Swift protocol (RoomBubbleCellDataProtocol) that captures the public API surface of RoomBubbleCellData.h. All 27 consuming files should depend on the protocol instead of the concrete class. This enables parallel Swift migration — a new Swift implementation can conform to the protocol while the ObjC version remains for untouched consumers. Thread-safety contracts (main-thread-only property access, atomic flags like isKeyVerificationOperationPending) should be documented as protocol requirements.

Extract Interface: MXKRoomBubbleCellData is already partially abstracted via MXKRoomBubbleCellDataStoring protocol. Complete the extraction by ensuring all consumers reference MXKRoomBubbleCellDataStoring rather than the concrete class. For Swift migration, create a Swift protocol mirroring MXKRoomBubbleCellDataStoring and use Wrap Method to add Swift-native thread-safety (actor isolation or @MainActor) without modifying existing ObjC consumers.

Sprout Class: MatrixKit is an umbrella import aggregating many types. Create focused Swift modules (e.g., MatrixKitRoomModels, MatrixKitFormatters) that expose only the needed symbols. Replace umbrella #import "MatrixKit.h" with targeted imports to reduce coupling surface. This also helps the compiler with incremental builds during migration.
